@@U03349@@
Fast as the giant ones Up there upheave it, Seize it, you pliant ones, Never to leave it. Search every cranny in Ranging and rifling; None that there’s any in Can be too trifling. The murkiest, shiniest, Fail not to explore it; Each speck, the tiniest, Seize it and store it. Work with a will, Till all is rolled out: Move the hill as it will, Just get the gold out!

@@U03351@@
(To the ANTS returning with the gold.)

@@U03352@@
Bring it in here! Bring it! Bring it! Pile it high! Our claws will grasp it better than any bolt! No treasure’s too great for us to guard!

@@U03354@@
Surprise! Here we are! And already in place! Better not to ask how or where from, because we don’t have a clue. Really, all we can say is that we're here. We figure there's nowhere not worth living; that it can be cheerful anywhere. And wherever a chink in a rock appears, a dwarf is sure to turn up soon. In pairs, of course, man and wife, industrious couple, too, a model pair, to be sure.
translation:
@@U03349@@
像巨人一样快，在那里举起它，抓住它，你们这些顺从的人，永远不要离开它。搜索测距和步枪中的每一个缝隙；里面的一切都不会太琐碎。最阴暗的，最闪亮的，不去探索它；每一个斑点，最微小的，抓住它并储存它。意志坚定，直到一切都铺开：随心所欲地移山，把金子拿出来！

@@U03351@@
（致带着金币归来的蚂蚁队。）

@@U03352@@
把它带到这里来！拿来吧！拿来吧！堆得高高的！我们的爪子比任何螺栓都更能抓住它！没有什么宝藏是我们守护不了的！

@@U03354@@
惊喜！我们到了！并且已经就位！最好不要问如何或从哪里来，因为我们不知道。真的，我们只能说我们在这里。我们认为没有什么地方不值得居住；任何地方都可以是快乐的。岩石上只要出现一个缝隙，矮人肯定很快就会出现。当然，夫妻俩也是一对，勤劳的夫妻，无疑是模范夫妻。
